nodes.description: Linked IPowerPoke/PowerPoke contract address used by PowerOracle to authorize pokers, pay rewards and trigger slashing.
Mapping(bytes32 => Price) of official prices and timestamps per symbol hash; written by _savePrice and read by priceInternal and getIntervalStatus.
Mapping(uint256 => uint256) of last slasher heartbeat update timestamps per slasher user id.
Mapping(bytes32 => Observation) holding the newest Uniswap cumulative-price observation window per symbol hash.
Mapping(bytes32 => Observation) holding the lagging Uniswap cumulative-price observation window per symbol hash.
Immutable minimum number of seconds required before the Uniswap accumulator window is rotated forward.
Immutable ERC20 CVP token handle used for reward payouts and swaps to WETH.
Guard flag toggled by the nonReentrant modifier that protects PowerPoke.reward and PowerPoke.slashReporter from reentrancy.
Mapping(address => Client) of client configuration, credit balance, gas price limit and slashing permissions.
Aggregate of all client credits held by PowerPoke.
Mapping(uint256 => uint256) of accrued CVP rewards per staking user id, withdrawable via withdrawRewards.
Mapping(uint256 => User) of staking user records: adminKey, pokerKey, deposit, pending deposit/withdrawal and timeouts.
External reporter poke entry point; guarded by onlyReporter, onlyEOA and whenNotPaused, fetches ETH/CVP prices and updates symbol prices.
External slasher poke entry point; validates GREATER_THAN_MAX interval, updates slasher timestamp and invokes powerPoke.slashReporter.
Permissionless poke entry point that refreshes prices for a supplied list of symbols without paying rewards.
Slasher heartbeat entry point that enforces a minimum delta via powerPoke.getSlasherHeartbeat and pays a CVP reward.
Client-facing reward function protected by nonReentrant and whenNotPaused; computes compensation/bonus, debits client credit and optionally pays out in ETH through Uniswap.
Client-facing slashing entry point protected by nonReentrant; forwards to PowerPokeStaking.slashHDH after checking client active/canSlash flags.
Withdraws accrued CVP rewards for a user id after validating the admin (or poker) key against the staking contract.
Adds CVP credit for an active client, pulling tokens with transferFrom.
Client-owner-only credit withdrawal that returns CVP tokens to a destination address.
Internal helper approving CVP to the Uniswap router and swapping CVP to ETH for a recipient.
Internal price fetch/save routine that validates REPORTER price source, checks report intervals and persists the new price.
Internal writer that stores a price with the current block timestamp into the prices mapping.
Virtual TWAP computation that derives the anchor price from the Uniswap cumulative accumulator deltas.
Rotates old/new observation windows when the anchor period elapsed and returns cumulative/old values.
View helper classifying the elapsed time since the last price update into LESS_THAN_MIN / OK / GREATER_THAN_MAX.
Owner-only setter replacing the linked powerPoke contract address.
Initializer setting the owner and the linked powerPoke contract.
Slasher-only routine that reduces the current HDH deposit, credits the slasher and transfers the reservoir share of CVP.
Creates a pending deposit for a user id, pulling CVP via transferFrom.
Admin-key-only activation of a pending deposit after the deposit timeout elapsed.
Admin-key-only creation of a pending withdrawal with a timeout.
Admin-key-only execution of a pending withdrawal transferring CVP to the destination address.
Permissionless routine replacing the current HDH with a candidate holding a strictly larger deposit.
View function computing the bonus CVP for a poker based on gas used, deposit and bonus plan ratios.
View function returning min(tx.gasprice, fast gas oracle, client gas price limit).
View computation of slasher reward, reservoir reward and total slash amounts for a slashee id and multiplier.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization checks, credit accounting and reward attribution.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used for report intervals, observations and slasher heartbeats.
Transaction origin compared against msg.sender in the onlyEOA modifier.
External ERC20 transfer of CVP tokens out of the contract in withdrawRewards/withdrawCredit.
External ERC20 transferFrom pulling CVP tokens from the caller in addCredit.
External Uniswap router swap of CVP into ETH with zero minimum output.
Cross-contract call from PowerOracle into PowerPoke.reward performed inside a modifier after the poke body.
Cross-contract call from PowerOracle into PowerPoke.slashReporter which forwards to staking slashing logic.
External CVP transfer to the reservoir address inside PowerPokeStaking.slashHDH.
External CVP transfer to a caller-supplied destination inside executeWithdrawal.
Chained SafeMath mul/div computation of gasUsed * userDeposit * bonusNumerator / bonusDenominator / perGas.
SafeMath subtraction block.timestamp.sub(prices[symbolHash_].timestamp) driving interval status decisions.
Reporter user id parameter of pokeFromReporter, forwarded to powerPoke.authorizeReporter and reward.
Array of asset symbols to poke in pokeFromReporter.
Opaque reward configuration bytes forwarded to powerPoke.reward.
Slasher user id parameter of pokeFromSlasher, forwarded to authorization, timestamp update and slashReporter.
Number of symbols supplied in the poke call, bounded by require(len > 0).
ETH price cached during poke execution and reused as the conversion factor for other assets.
User id parameter of PowerPoke.reward used for deposit lookup and reward accrual.
Caller-supplied gas usage parameter of reward, possibly augmented with fixed compensations.
Bonus plan identifier supplied by the client when calling reward.
ABI-encoded PokeRewardOptions bytes decoded inside reward to determine payout recipient and ETH/CVP compensation.
RewardHelperStruct memory accumulator holding gas price, oracle prices and computed CVP/ETH amounts.
Decoded PokeRewardOptions holding the payout destination and compensateInETH flag.
Destination address parameter of withdrawRewards, validated to be non-zero.
Cached rewards[userId_] amount zeroed before the CVP transfer to prevent double withdrawal.
Candidate user id parameter of setHDH whose deposit is compared with the current HDH deposit.
CVP amount parameter of _payoutCompensationInETH approved to the router and swapped.
Recipient parameter of _payoutCompensationInETH receiving the swapped ETH.
Symbol hash key parameter of _savePrice selecting the prices mapping slot.
Price value parameter of _savePrice downcast with SafeCast before storage.
TokenConfig loaded in _fetchAndSavePrice to validate price source and compute the anchor price.
Slashing multiplier parameter of slashHDH feeding getSlashAmount.
Deposit amount parameter of createDeposit transferred from the caller.

edges.reason: powerPoke storage is read inside the onlyReporter modifier invoked by pokeFromReporter.
powerPoke storage is read inside the onlySlasher modifier invoked by pokeFromSlasher.
powerPoke is used by slasherHeartbeat for authorization, heartbeat lookup and reward payout.
setPowerPoke writes the privileged powerPoke contract reference.
initialize writes the powerPoke contract reference during initialization.
msg.sender is passed to powerPoke.authorizeReporter to derive the caller identity.
msg.sender is passed to powerPoke.authorizeNonReporter to derive the caller identity.
msg.sender is emitted in the Poke event.
clients[msg.sender].active and canSlash gate slashReporter execution.
clients[msg.sender] determines credit, fee configuration and reward accounting in reward.
msg.sender is validated via POWER_POKE_STAKING.requireValidAdminOrPokerKey in withdrawRewards.
msg.sender is the token source in the addCredit transferFrom call.
onlyEOA requires msg.sender == tx.origin before the pokefromReporter body executes.
onlyEOA requires msg.sender == tx.origin before the pokeFromSlasher body executes.
onlyEOA requires msg.sender == tx.origin before the slasherHeartbeat body executes.
block.timestamp determines the delta used by getIntervalStatus to classify report intervals.
block.timestamp is the minuend of the interval subtraction, making the interval decision miner-influenceable.
block.timestamp is stored as the price timestamp in _savePrice.
block.timestamp is compared with newObservation.timestamp to rotate Uniswap windows.
block.timestamp bounds the anchor price computation in fetchAnchorPrice.
block.timestamp subtraction enforces the slasher heartbeat interval in slasherHeartbeat.
getIntervalStatusForIntervals result gates whether _fetchAndSavePrice performs an update.
The TokenConfig supplied to _fetchAndSavePrice is forwarded to fetchAnchorPrice.
The computed price and symbol hash are passed to _savePrice.
fetchAnchorPrice consumes the cumulative and old observation values returned by pokeWindowValues.
_savePrice writes the new Price entry into the prices mapping.
getIntervalStatusForIntervals reads prices[symbolHash].timestamp to compute the delta.
_fetchAndSavePrice reads stored prices while evaluating interval status.
pokeFromReporter loops over symbols_ and invokes _fetchAndSavePrice for each asset.
pokeFromSlasher loops over symbols_ and requires every asset to be GREATER_THAN_MAX via _fetchAndSavePrice.
poke loops over symbols_ and invokes _fetchAndSavePrice for each asset.
The onlyReporter modifier performs an external powerPoke.reward call after the poke body, creating a cross-contract callback.
pokeFromSlasher invokes powerPoke.slashReporter as an external cross-contract call.
poke reaches state-changing price writes and interacts with the linked powerPoke system.
PowerOracle.pokeFromSlasher calls powerPoke.slashReporter which executes slashing flow in PowerPoke.
The external powerPoke.reward call re-enters the PowerPoke reward function across contracts.
PowerPoke.slashReporter forwards an external call to POWER_POKE_STAKING.slashHDH.
slashHDH calls getSlashAmount to compute slasher and reservoir rewards.
The reservoirReward computed in slashHDH is transferred to the reservoir address.
slashHDH mutates the HDH and slasher deposit records in the users mapping.
reward reads and decrements clients[msg.sender].credit and reads fee configuration.
reward accounting interacts with the client credit totals maintained by addCredit/withdrawCredit.
reward accrues rewards[userId_] for later withdrawal.
reward calls getPokerBonus to compute the bonus CVP component.
reward calls getGasPriceFor to cap the gas price used in compensation.
When compensateInETH is set, reward triggers an external Uniswap swap through _payoutCompensationInETH after state updates.
_payoutCompensationInETH approves CVP and calls the Uniswap router swap with zero minimum output.
withdrawRewards transfers CVP tokens after zeroing rewards[userId_].
withdrawCredit transfers CVP tokens after decrementing the client credit.
getPokerBonus performs the chained multiplication/division that may overflow or divide by zero.
The nonReentrant modifier reads and writes _status around PowerPoke.reward execution.
The nonReentrant modifier reads and writes _status around PowerPoke.slashReporter execution.
slashHDH reads and writes user deposits and pending values stored in the staking users mapping.
createDeposit validates the user record and creates a pending deposit entry.
executeDeposit moves pending deposit into the active deposit of the user record.
createWithdrawal decrements the user deposit and records a pending withdrawal.
executeWithdrawal clears the user pending withdrawal fields before sending tokens.
setHDH is permissionless and rewrites the HDH record based on a strictly larger candidate deposit.
executeWithdrawal performs an external CVP transfer to a caller-supplied destination.
createDeposit performs an external transferFrom pulling CVP from the caller.
reporterId_ drives the authorizeReporter and reward calls in pokeFromReporter.
symbols_ is iterated to select which price feeds are refreshed.
rewardOpts_ is forwarded verbatim to powerPoke.reward.
slasherId_ drives authorization, heartbeat update and slashReporter in pokeFromSlasher.
len bounds the symbol processing loop in pokeFromReporter.
ethPrice is passed as the conversion factor for non-ETH symbols.
userId_ selects the staking deposit and rewards slot in PowerPoke.reward.
gasUsed_ is caller-influenced input to the compensation formula in reward.
compensationPlan_ selects the bonus plan used by getPokerBonus.
pokeOptions_ is abi.decode'd into opts controlling recipient and compensation asset.
helper accumulates the gas price, CVP price and computed amounts used for credit accounting.
opts.to and opts.compensateInETH determine the payout path and recipient.
to_ is the CVP recipient in withdrawRewards.
rewardAmount is zeroed before the external transfer to prevent double withdrawal.
candidateId_ selects the user record compared against the current highest deposit in setHDH.
_cvpAmount is approved to the router and swapped for ETH.
_to is the ETH recipient in the Uniswap router call.
_symbolHash selects the prices mapping entry written by _savePrice.
price_ is downcast and stored as the new price value.
config determines the price source validation and is passed to fetchAnchorPrice.
times_ multiplies the deposit inside getSlashAmount, influencing the amount slashed.
amount_ is the CVP quantity pulled by createDeposit.

normalization_plan.reason: reporterId_ is only meaningful inside pokeFromReporter and its authorization/reward calls, so it is folded into that function node.
symbols_ is a transient loop input of pokeFromReporter and is merged into the enclosing function.
rewardOpts_ is opaque data forwarded by pokeFromReporter to powerPoke.reward and carries no standalone semantics.
slasherId_ only parameterizes pokeFromSlasher authorization, heartbeat and slashing calls.
len is a derived loop bound for the pokeFromReporter symbol loop and is normalized into the function.
ethPrice is a cached intermediate passed into the price fetch routine from pokeFromReporter.
userId_ is only used to index deposits and rewards inside PowerPoke.reward.
gasUsed_ is caller-supplied input consumed entirely by the reward compensation computation.
compensationPlan_ only selects a bonus plan inside the reward flow.
pokeOptions_ is decoded and consumed only within PowerPoke.reward.
helper is a memory accumulator whose lifetime is confined to PowerPoke.reward.
opts is the decoded form of pokeOptions_ and exists only during reward execution.
to_ is the destination argument consumed by the withdrawRewards transfer.
rewardAmount is a temporary snapshot of rewards[userId_] used by withdrawRewards.
candidateId_ only indexes the users mapping during the setHDH comparison.
_cvpAmount is the swap input parameter of _payoutCompensationInETH.
_to is the ETH recipient parameter of _payoutCompensationInETH.
_symbolHash is the storage key argument of _savePrice.
price_ is the value argument stored by _savePrice.
config is a transient TokenConfig loaded and consumed inside _fetchAndSavePrice.
times_ is the slashing multiplier consumed by slashHDH through getSlashAmount.
amount_ is the deposit quantity consumed by createDeposit's transferFrom call.
